summary: Removed the manual add-edge UI from graph.html header. Deleted: the .addedge control (edgeFrom/edgeTo selects, edgeWs input, edgeAdd button), populateEdgeSelects() + addEdge() functions, the edgeAdd click listener, and the now-dead lastTasks global + its tick() assignment/call (tick now just sets lastState). Header is now title + view toggle + summary only. Verified node --check SYNTAX OK; 0 dangling refs to addedge/edgeFrom/edgeTo/edgeWs/edgeAdd/addEdge/populateEdgeSelects/lastTasks; Flow+Cloud toggle still served. The daemon's /overlay/edge endpoint is untouched (edges can still be created via MCP add_dependency); only the dashboard control was removed.
